record.question: (iii) Grant of child care leave to a female Government servant and a single male Government servant under sub-rule (1) shall be subject to the following conditions, namely:
options: it shall not be granted for more than two spells in a calendar year
in case of a single female Government servant, the grant of leave in three spells in a calendar year shall be extended to six spells in a calendar year
child care leave may not be granted for a period less than three days at a time
child care leave may not be granted for a period more than 45 days at a time
record.explanation: The PDF (page 3, Q16(iii)) asks the conditions for child care leave under CCS (Leave) Rules; the rule limits grant to two spells in a calendar year, which matches the first option. The other options (three-to-six spells extension, minimum three days, maximum 45 days) do not match the rule as I recall it.

record.question: (i) Joining time cannot be combined with
record.explanation: The PDF (page 4, Q23(i)) asks what joining time cannot be combined with; under the CCS (Joining Time) Rules, joining time is not combined with extraordinary leave. Earned, half pay and casual leave are the forms that can be combined, based on my recollection of the rules.
